title: Tekken 4
tagline: The King of Iron Fist Tournament returns.

source.label: Tekken 4 move and combo archive
source.note: Commands use 1/2/3/4 notation. Frame results are listed per hit; KD means knockdown and — means not applicable. Stagger advantage does not always equal time unable to block. Combo restrictions appear beside each route; recovery setups are not guaranteed. Data combines Tekken Wiki with Tekken Zaibatsu movelists, frame tables and community guides.

characters.name: Jin Kazama

throws.name: Thunder Reverse
throws.notes: Hold forward with 2+4 for the extended-reach version.

moves.name: Needle Shrine Scraper
moves.notes: After the first two hits are blocked, sidestep right to avoid the final hit. On normal hit the final hit is blockable. A counter hit on the first attack guarantees the undelayed string; delaying lets the opponent block.

combos.name: Counter-hit Laser Scraper finish
combos.notes: Do not delay the launcher. The final uppercut uses electric timing.

unblockables.name: Charged Laser Scraper
unblockables.notes: Hold the final attack for the long charge. It is escapable even after a counter-hit opener; do not treat it as a guaranteed combo.

unblockables.name: Just-frame Laser Scraper
unblockables.notes: Charge and release the final attack at the just-frame window. After the first two hits connect normally, the earlier release is guaranteed; the later release can be sidestepped. After the first two hits are blocked, both versions can be sidestepped right.

mechanics.title: Position change
mechanics.text: 1+3 replaces the regular left throw. Add a direction to reposition the opponent or push them into a wall; the escape is 1.

mechanics.title: Wall recovery
mechanics.text: A close standing power hit can cause an inescapable wall stun. Airborne wall hits and more distant impacts can allow recovery: 1/2 rolls right and 3/4 rolls left once the feet reach the ground. Wall angle and spacing matter.

mechanics.title: Wall jump
mechanics.text: With your back near a wall, b,b,u/b performs a wall jump. Its long animation can be interrupted.
